implemented: ellipsis restoration from a pending continuation gate
conservative sarcasm detection from semantic incongruity

cases: multi-turn ellipsis restores task and required benefit
negative stance persists and suspends the gate
sarcastic praise after failure is not approval
software context selects a critical-incident metaphor

known_limits: The analyzer is deterministic and vocabulary-bounded rather than a general natural-language model.
Only user turns are committed to pragmatic memory; assistant dialogue acts are not yet ingested as memory events.
Novel cultural sarcasm and unseen metaphors can remain unresolved.
Memory is intentionally bounded to eight task frames and sixteen recent turn summaries.
Ambiguous readings request clarification instead of being probabilistically guessed.

repository.note: The worktree contains this stage plus pre-existing and prior-stage changes; no unrelated change was removed.
